title: Define an ancestry-matched cohort

blocks.what_we_do: Apply the predefined six-standard-deviation rule on the first four projected PCs.
blocks.why: This teaching design focuses the main analysis on a broadly European-reference-matched cohort. For each of PC1 to PC4, standardise the study score using the European reference mean and population standard deviation. Flag a sample if its largest absolute standardised distance exceeds six. This is a study-specific inclusion policy, not a universal ancestry classification. Apply it before inspecting association results and report exclusions.
blocks.you_need: Reference and study projections from 5.4; reference labels from 5.5.
blocks.command:
```{r s5-6}
ref <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.4", "ref_scores"), ".sscore"))
study <- guided_table(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "5.4", "study_scores"), ".sscore"))
metadata <- guided_table(file.path(cfg$data_dir, "pca_reference", "ref1000g_grch38.psam"))
eur <- metadata$SuperPop[match(ref$IID, metadata$IID)] == "EUR"
columns <- paste0("PC", 1:4, "_AVG")
r <- sapply(ref[eur, columns, drop = FALSE], as.numeric)
s <- sapply(study[columns], as.numeric)
centre <- colMeans(r)
spread <- sqrt(colMeans(sweep(r, 2, centre, "-")^2))
z <- sweep(sweep(s, 2, centre, "-"), 2, spread, "/")
bad <- study$IID[apply(abs(z), 1, max) > 6]
remove <- guided_list(bad, guided_path(cfg, "5.6", "remove.txt"), TRUE)
run_plink(cfg, c("--pfile", guided_path(cfg, "4.6"), "--remove", remove, "--make-pgen", "--out", guided_path(cfg, "5.6")))
ops <- guided_replay_lists(cfg, "5.6", "4.6")
guided_register(cfg, "5.6", "5.4", 1811, 238513, operations = ops)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

```sh
bin/plink2 --pfile results/guided/s4-6_state --remove results/guided/s5-6_remove.txt --make-pgen --out results/guided/s5-6_state --threads 2 --memory 2048
```

R calculates the explicit reference-based rule and writes the selected IID list. `--remove` applies that prespecified list to the complete study matrix; `--make-pgen` saves the retained cohort. `--pfile` reads the specified native genotype set; `--out` names reports. `--threads 2` limits worker threads. `--memory 2048` sets the workspace budget in MiB.
blocks.expected_result:
33 remaining outlier records excluded; 1,811 samples and 238,513 variants remain. Some originally simulated outliers left during earlier QC, so this is not the initial total outlier count.

The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks and instructor reference counts passed on Windows.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the named input and the previous step. Keep the command and console logs; do not substitute files from a different dataset version. See [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.what_this_check_can_reveal: Large reference-relative ancestry differences and possible technical outliers. A mismatch demands review and a documented study design, not a claim that excluded people are biologically unsuitable in general.
blocks.quick_check:
Why is the rule calculated on four PCs rather than only the two shown in the plot?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

Separation that is weak or invisible on the first two axes can appear on later axes.

</details>
